title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on John 1: the Word in the beginning, the testimony of John, the Lamb of God and the first disciples.

questions.text: What does the first verse say about the Word?
questions.explanation: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

answers.text: The Word was a prophet sent from God
The Word was with God, and the Word was God
The Word was made through the world
The Word was the light that John carried

questions.text: What does the chapter say about all things that were made?
questions.explanation: All things were made through him, and without him nothing was made that has been made.

answers.text: They were made before the Word existed
They were made by the will of man
They were made through Moses
They were all made through him

questions.text: What does the text say about the man named John and the light?
questions.explanation: He came as a witness to testify about the light; he was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about it.

answers.text: He was not the light, but was sent to testify about the light
He was the true light coming into the world
He was the Word that became flesh from the beginning
He refused to testify about the light to anyone

questions.text: What happened to the Word, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The Word became flesh and lived among us, and we saw his glory, full of grace and truth.

answers.text: The Word returned to heaven unseen
The Word was written down in the law
The Word became flesh and lived among us
The Word stayed hidden in the darkness

questions.text: What did John declare when the priests and Levites asked who he was?
questions.explanation: He declared, and did not deny, but declared, "I am not the Christ."

answers.text: "I am Elijah returned"
"I am not the Christ"
"I am the prophet you await"
"I am the Son of God"

questions.text: What did John say when he saw Jesus coming to him?
questions.explanation: He said, "Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!"

answers.text: "Behold, the King of Israel, who comes to reign!"
"Behold, the voice crying in the wilderness of Judea!"
"Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!"
"Behold, the teacher who has come from God to us!"

questions.text: What did John testify that he had seen descending out of heaven?
questions.explanation: John testified that he had seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

answers.text: A pillar of fire
An angel in dazzling clothing
A bright cloud over the Jordan
The Spirit descending like a dove

questions.text: What name did Jesus give to Simon the son of Jonah?
questions.explanation: Jesus looked at him and said, "You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas," which is by interpretation, Peter.

answers.text: Cephas
Israel
Didymus
Jonah

questions.text: What did Nathanael say when Philip told him about Jesus of Nazareth?
questions.explanation: Nathanael said to him, "Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?" and Philip said, "Come and see."

answers.text: "Is he not the son of Joseph?"
"Where is he staying tonight?"
"Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?"
"Has Moses written about him?"

questions.text: Where did Jesus say he had seen Nathanael before Philip called him?
questions.explanation: Jesus answered him that before Philip called him, when he was under the fig tree, he saw him.

answers.text: At the well outside the town
Under the fig tree
In the synagogue at Nazareth
Beside the Jordan with John
